get.summary:
Schema-only endpoint. Exists so Schema is included in the
OpenAPI schema, which lets the frontend generate a type-safe map of hub events
to their payloads. Tagged "internal" so it does not appear in production swagger,
but the schema itself is emitted during swagger export.

Streams a vault file using a one-time download token.
No authentication required — the token itself is the credential.

POST /api/automation-triggers/webhook/{token} — anonymous inbound webhook trigger entry point.

get.summary: GET /api/automations/catalog/node-kinds — returns the registered node-kind catalog enriched with database choices.
Reads the append-only audit trail, newest first, keyset-paginated on the monotonic Id.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Exact CLR type name of the audited entity, e.g. Agent.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Exact primary key of the audited entity.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Exact operation. Binds from the name (Modified) or from EF's int.

parameters.name: actorId
parameters.description: Exact actor id. Ignored when NoActor is set.

parameters.name: noActor
parameters.description:
When true, returns only rows whose actor is null — an agent or system save. A null
actor is meaningful rather than missing data, and an absent ActorId
already means "any actor", so the case needs its own flag. Wins over
ActorId when both are supplied.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the event timestamp, UTC.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on the event timestamp, UTC.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-text contains match over EntityType and the Changes JSON.
Case-insensitive for ASCII via SQL LIKE; % and _ in the needle are
escaped, so it stays a plain contains match. Unindexed — a full scan of Changes.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Keyset cursor: only rows with an Id strictly below this are returned. Pass the
previous page's nextCursor; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Clamped to 1..200 server-side.

post.summary: Idempotently starts the package that owns a command before invocation.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Composite cursor of the form ISO-timestamp pipe ID-guid; rows strictly older, or
equal timestamp with a smaller Id, are returned. Bare ISO timestamp also accepted.

HubEventsSchema.description:
Schema-only type describing the payload of every SignalR hub event.
Property names match the SignalR event names sent by the server, so the
generated TypeScript type doubles as the event map on the client.

architecture.description: The agent's CPU architecture (e.g. x64, arm64).

hardwareId.description: The hardware identifier reported by the agent.

listenerId.description: Id of the listener the agent registered through.

status.description: The current status of the agent.

registeredAt.description: The date and time when the agent was registered.

lastCheckIn.description: The date and time of the agent's last check-in.

sleepInterval.description:
Callback interval in seconds. Client uses this to compute the
live/stale/dead dot color per the 2x/5x sleep thresholds.

parentAgentId.description: The ID of the parent agent through which traffic is relayed (if any).

socks5EgressEnabled.description: Operator opt-in flag for routing operator SOCKS5 traffic through this agent.

profileId.description: The profile-id (profile id) the agent is currently using.

isStream.description: True when the agent uses a persistent stream connection.

HubEventsEntityDeleted.description: Payload for every *Deleted event: identifies the row that disappeared.

HubEventsAgentHeartbeat.description:
Compact event sent on each agent heartbeat. Carries only the fields the UI
needs to recompute liveness so the hub does not fan out a full agent entity
every few seconds per connected operator.

displayName.description: Display label: module name for module payloads, command type for builtin commands.

AgentTaskProgressResponse.description: Transient live-output event for one in-flight task.

filePath.description: The path to the built agent file.

isScanned.description: Whether the agent has been scanned by VirusTotal.

lastScanned.description: When the agent was last scanned on VirusTotal.

hasAlerted.description: Whether an alert has been sent for positive detections.

createdBy.description: The user who initiated the build.

nodeId.description: Node id within the run's graph.

inputJson.description: Interpolated input JSON, truncated past 64 KiB.

re-typing the secret.

escape hatch and it's admin-gated and audited.

Optional explicit set of known connection ids. When null, the server

first persisting the connections.

AuditListResponse.description: One page of the audit trail.

items.description: Events on this page, newest first.

nextCursor.description:
Id of the last row on this page. Send it back as before for the next page;
null means this was the last page.

id.description: Row id. Monotonic, and doubles as the keyset cursor.

at.description: UTC timestamp of the save that produced this row.

actorId.description: Authenticated user id, or null for an agent / system save. Filter on this.

actorName.description:
Username of the actor for display, falling back to the raw ActorId when
the user no longer exists. Null exactly when ActorId is null.

entityType.description: CLR type name of the entity that changed.

entityId.description: Primary key of the entity that changed, when it has a single Guid Id.

op.description:
Added, Modified or Deleted. A name, not EF's int, so the wire
contract holds if EF ever renumbers EntityState.

changes.description:
JSON snapshot. Added and Deleted carry a flat property map; Modified carries
{ prop: [old, new] }. Keys prefixed _ snapshot a loaded navigation,
e.g. _Agent.

AuditListRequest.description: Query for one page of the audit trail. Every filter is optional and they combine with AND.

scanId.description: The ID of the scan in VirusTotal.

lastScanned.description: When the agent was last scanned on VirusTotal.

detectionCount.description: The number of detections from VirusTotal.

totalEngines.description: The total number of antivirus engines that scanned the file.

sleepEncryption.description: Encrypt agent heap and image sections while sleeping between check-ins.

mbaDepth.description:
MBA obfuscation recursion depth (0-6). Debug builds OOM at 6; the
UI drops it to 2 when Debug mode is on.

dllExportName.description:
For DLL builds: exported function name that executes the payload.
Default "Run" if empty. Used for DLL sideloading — name must match
what the host application imports.

sacrificialDlls.description:
System32 DLLs for stealth memory backing. Null = agent-side defaults.
Ordered smallest to largest; agent falls back to the next one if a
path can't be mapped.

maxRetries.description:
Max retry attempts for failed check-ins and heartbeats before giving up.
Default 10. Registration uses 3x this value.

httpBackend.description:
HTTP transport: "WinINet" (default), "WinHTTP", or "Raw".
WinINet uses the browser TLS stack and inherits system proxy settings.

killDate.description:
Optional ISO-8601 UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) baked into the
agent binary. Empty/null falls back to the Zig builder default.

SharedBuildsPayloadDebugLevel.description:
Zig's four optimize modes. ReleaseFast is the default; Debug keeps
symbols and skips optimization, which is what you want when the agent
is crashing and you need a readable disassembly.
